mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_chunk( knowledge_base_id, document_id, chunk_key, chunk_index, content, content_hash, token_count, page_no, section_title, metadata, vector_ref, status ) VALUES( #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentId}, #{chunkKey}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{tokenCount}, #{pageNo}, #{sectionTitle}, #{metadata}, #{vectorRef}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM document_chunk WHERE document_id = #{documentId} and status = 'NEW' ORDER BY chunk_index
SELECT * FROM document_chunk WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY chunk_index
